reason: It only changes whether stack traces of errors thrown while next build prerenders are source-mapped in the build output (enablePrerenderSourceMaps already existed and still accepts the same values), so no application code or config depends on the default.

The reimplemented check only accepts requests the old one rejected (form posts without an Origin header, same-origin posts whose Origin differs from the server URL behind a proxy) and rejects none it accepted for real browser headers; tried a form-encoded webhook endpoint and a proxied form, and code written for the old check (relying on it, disabling it, or adding its own origin check) works unchanged, so no application code depends on the change.

Re-checked v3 S1 against 16.2.6: experimental.optimisticRouting already existed there undocumented and off, so code written for 16.2 never sets it; turning it on only lets the browser client router predict route trees for already-seen URL patterns to skip a prefetch round trip (deopting for rewrites and interception), which renders the same result, a prefetch optimization no application code or config depends on.

experimental.varyParams (undocumented and off in 16.2.6) only changes how the browser client router keys its segment cache, reusing a segment entry across URLs whose params that segment never reads instead of refetching it; the rendered output for any URL is the same, so it is a caching optimization no application code or config depends on.
